Notes: Called D1 in paper.  Our primary delay measure, we use the daily stock level version.  OP focuses on complicated two-stage portfolio-based version
Detailed Definition: Each July regress stock return on day $t$ on market return in $t, t-1, \ldots, t-4$ using observations from July 1 of the previous year to June 30 of the current year.  Then regress again with no market return lags.  PriceDelay Rsq = 1 - [Rsq from second regression]/[Rsq from first regression]
